name: Amber Blackout v3
author: euklides
description: Same as v2 but also patches the hardcoded #212121 dark gray (title bar, pad grid lines, loader bg) to pure black via code-level instruction patch.

0.description: Pad grid borders, cell outlines on PADS/FX/MIX screens. Subtle dark amber line.

1.description: Main interactive surface: piano white keys, KEYS grid cells, knob dial arcs, recording level meter bars. Should be very dark (keys are dark, arcs drawn on top).

2.description: Primary text EVERYWHERE: headers (1:1, Seq 1), param labels (LEVEL, PITCH), values, pad names, VEL label, toolbar text. Must contrast against both dark bg and orange surfaces.

3.description: Selected/active row highlight background: highlighted setting on TOOLS, active scene on SONG, active FX slot, selected row on Conf/MOD. Bright amber = 'you are here'.

4.description: Primary interactive accent: vel slider fill, pressed key highlight, active toggle buttons (Loop1), file browser selection bar, active FX type button. The 'action' color.

5.description: Recording/alert red. REC button active state. Keep red for safety visibility.

6.description: THE dominant surface fill: empty pad cells, toolbar/header bar bg, settings row bg, black piano keys, inactive tabs, mod indicator blocks. Should be dark — this is what was too bright last time.

7.description: Dark background behind parameter knob groups on Main/LFO/FX screens. Should be near-black.

8.description: Secondary text for settings rows: Headphone, Out 1 Vol, Launch Mode labels and values on TOOLS/Conf screens. Slightly dimmer than primary text [2].

9.description: Secondary accent: small indicator squares, subtle accent marks. One of 6 stock cyan slots.

10.description: Active/positive green: on states, playback active indicators. Keep green for semantic meaning.

11.description: Alert/negative red: recording state, error indicators. Keep red for semantic meaning.

12.description: Third dark background instance. Used for specific panel areas. Near-black.

13.description: True black. Deepest screen background behind all UI — PSET file list bg, empty Song area, base layer.

14.description: File/preset list item text (PSET browser names), settings value text. May also be 'before first selection' menu text. Match [2] for consistency or slightly different for distinction.

15.description: Divider/separator lines between rows in settings lists. Subtle amber-tinted line.

16.description: Mid-level UI chrome: scroll indicators, secondary borders, disabled state elements.

17.description: Second active/positive green instance. Pad active indicators, mute toggles. Match [10].

19.description: Yellow highlight for sequence active steps or special indicators. Gold tone.

20.description: Third alert red instance. Clipping or destructive action indicators. Match [11].

21.description: Tertiary text / dimmed labels. Less prominent than [2] or [14]. Muted amber.

22.description: Pad/track color slot 1. Stock was mint. Used for per-pad coloring in mixer/sequences.

23.description: Pad/track color slot 2. Stock was purple. Darker amber for second track color.

24.description: Inner fill of parameter knob boxes on Main/LFO screens. Slightly lighter than true black. Match [1].

25.description: Dimmed accent background. Dark amber tint behind vel slider track and other subtle accent areas.

26.description: Level/VU meter fill on recording screen. Bright amber accent.

27.description: Special indicator. Stock was olive. Sequence step or specific UI state marker.

28.description: Mixer volume level bars on MIX screen. Bright amber horizontal bars.

29.description: White text alternate: toolbar button text, tab labels, or value text in specific views. Match [2].

30.description: Active tab background on pad parameter screens (Main/Pos/LFO/Conf bottom tabs). Clearly visible as the highlighted tab.

31.description: Secondary accent highlight. Stock was pink. Additional per-pad or UI highlighting.

32.description: Third white text instance. Tab or button text in specific views. Match [2].
